title: Build Image-Based Video Studio System (No Expensive AI)
description:
SETUP COMPLETE VIDEO STUDIO USING IMAGES AND STOCK FOOTAGE

DO NOT BUY expensive AI video generation packages. Use local and free tools.

STUDIO SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE:

1. SCRIPT PIPELINE:
   - Create storyboard from script
   - Break script into scenes/chapters
   - Generate image prompts for each scene
   - Use topic/theme-based approach

2. IMAGE GENERATION (FREE - Local):
   - Stable Diffusion with RTX 5060
   - Generate backgrounds, characters, visuals
   - Batch processing for multiple scenes
   - Image prompts based on story/theme

3. STOCK FOOTAGE (FREE/Cheap):
   - Pexels API integration (free tier)
   - Pixabay API integration
   - Search by theme/topic keywords
   - Download and organize B-roll footage

4. AUDIO PIPELINE:
   - ElevenLabs free trial ( Vietnamese voice)
   - Script to speech conversion
   - Background music sourcing
   - Audio mixing

5. VIDEO ASSEMBLY (FREE):
   - FFmpeg for video rendering
   - Image sequences to video
   - Add stock footage between scenes
   - Transitions and effects
   - Add subtitles/captions

6. AUTOMATION:
   - Script -> Images -> Audio -> Video pipeline
   - Batch processing for multiple videos
   - Night rendering jobs
   - QC checkpoints

DELIVERABLES:
1. Working pipeline: Script -> Images + Footage -> Audio -> Video
2. Tested with sample video under 5 minutes
3. Cost per video calculation (should be near )
4. Documented workflow for content team

PRIORITY: Get this working before any paid AI video tools.
